skill: Handloom Warp Shedding & Selvage Tension Control

knowledge_package.title: Two-Shaft Plain Weave Shed Transition & Selvage Control
knowledge_package.summary: Coordinate foot treadles for warp shed alternation, shuttle transit, and uniform reed beat-up tension.

claims.statement: Depress treadle #1 fully to separate odd and even warp threads into a clean 45mm open shed before throwing shuttle.
The reed must beat the newly laid weft pick into the cloth fell only after the treadles alternate to lock the thread in place.

rubric.title: Handloom Plain Weave Shed & Tension Rubric
rubric.description: Deterministic scoring of shed clarity, pick locking sequence, and edge selvage straightness.

criteria.name: Warp shed separation clearance (> 40mm)
criteria.description: Treadle depression separates upper and lower warp layers without clinging threads.
criteria.observable_indicator: Minimum 40mm vertical aperture through entire shuttle flight path.

criteria.name: Pick alternation & beat-up sequence locking
criteria.description: Treadles must alternate before reed strikes to interlock weft pick.
criteria.observable_indicator: Reed contact occurs while shed is crossed in counter-position.

criteria.name: Selvage edge tension uniformity
criteria.description: Left and right edge warp yarns maintain linear alignment within +/-2mm.
criteria.observable_indicator: Edge deviation across 10 picks <= 2mm; no hourglassing or loops.

practice_task.title: Weave 12 Picks of Balanced Plain Weave
practice_task.instructions: Alternate treadles 1 and 2, pass wooden boat shuttle smoothly across open shed, and beat weft pick evenly into cloth fell.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Shuttle snagged two loose warp threads on left flank due to 28mm shed.
Beat on open shed without crossing treadles; weft pick slid backward (float defect).
Pulled shuttle yarn excessively, causing 6mm inward selvage waist.

feedback.summary: Targeted corrective feedback for the next attempt.

items.what_was_observed: Struck reed while the shed was still open in same position as previous pick.
items.what_differed: Struck reed while the shed was still open in same position as previous pick.
items.corrective_advice: Follow the rhythm: Throw shuttle -> Change treadle foot -> Beat reed. The foot switch locks the yarn.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Clean 48mm shed clearance with zero warp snagging.
Treadle crossed before every reed strike; weave interlock 100% verified.

lineage.adaptation_notes: State machine sequence synchronization reinforced through state snapshot matrix.
